symptom: `image` (the web Image pluggable widget) on a page with a native layout passed check with only a MDL-WIDGET55 warning and exec wrote it; mx check then failed CE6089 "Widget 'Image' is only supported on web documents.". `alter page <native page> { insert … { image … } }` was not judged at all.
cause: MDL-WIDGET55 was a warning because mxbuild's verdict had never been measured, and it only judged CREATE PAGE: check cannot see a stored document's platform.
fix: Web widget on a native page is an error naming CE6089. ALTER inserts and replaces are refused at exec when the mutator reports a native document (DocumentPlatform, or its layout). Native-on-web stays a warning.
insight: A rule left at warning 'because unmeasured' is a debt: one mx check on a fresh project (image, accordion, gallery on NativePhone_Default → CE6089 each; staticimage → 0) settled it. The native counterpart of the web image is the built-in staticimage/dynamicimage, not a pluggable widget.
test: mdl/executor/validate_widget_platform_test.go TestWidgetPlatform_WebOnNativeIsAnError_2619 (control: native on web stays a warning); failed with the severity reverted. Live 11.12.6: check refuses create, exec refuses alter insert, a web page alter still works, mx check 0 errors.
